capabilities: Lists the newest files in a sidebar view
Maintains a first-seen index in the plugin's data.json
Includes attachments and non-Markdown files in the same list
Filters by extension and excluded path prefixes
Sorts by first-seen index or modified time
disambiguation: Not a recently-modified or recently-opened list; it tracks when each file was first added to the vault.
extras: README also documents developer-only workflows: a sync command that copies main.js, manifest.json and styles.css to a Windows-local test vault, and a CDP smoke test that drives the plugin through Obsidian's Electron UI.
problem: Newly added attachments and non-Markdown files that have never been opened are hard to spot among the rest of the vault.
summary: Sidebar view that lists the newest files added to the vault, including attachments and other non-Markdown files that were never opened.
